title: Physics
description: ISC Class XI Physics: two theory papers totalling 80 marks (Paper 1: 1.5 hours, 35 marks; Paper 2: 1.5 hours, 35 marks; 10 marks practical-file/viva weightage via internal) plus 20 marks practical examination.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ISC Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Physics (www.cisce.org), corroborated by Oswal Publishers' 2026-27 reproduction.
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Units: Physical World and Measurement; Kinematics; Laws of Motion; Work, Energy and Power; Motion of System of Particles and Rigid Body; Gravitation; Properties of Bulk Matter; Heat and Thermodynamics; Oscillations and Waves; Friction, Circular Motion, Rotational Dynamics (as mapped in scope).

sections.title: Physics
sections.paperLabel: ISC Class XI · Two Theory Papers + Practical

chapters.title: Physical World and Measurement
chapters.blurb: Units, dimensions, dimensional analysis, significant figures and errors.

chapters.title: Kinematics
chapters.blurb: Motion in one and two dimensions, projectile motion, relative velocity.

chapters.title: Laws of Motion
chapters.blurb: Inertia, force, momentum, friction, circular dynamics, connected bodies.

chapters.title: Work, Energy and Power
chapters.blurb: Work-energy theorem, conservative forces, collisions in one dimension.

chapters.title: System of Particles and Rotational Motion
chapters.blurb: Centre of mass, torque, angular momentum, moment of inertia, rolling.

chapters.title: Gravitation
chapters.blurb: Newton's law, acceleration due to gravity, satellites, escape and orbital velocities.

chapters.title: Properties of Bulk Matter
chapters.blurb: Elasticity, pressure in fluids, viscosity, surface tension, Bernoulli's principle.

chapters.title: Heat and Thermodynamics
chapters.blurb: Thermal expansion, calorimetry, transfer of heat, first law, specific heats of gases.

chapters.title: Oscillations
chapters.blurb: Simple harmonic motion, energy in SHM, simple pendulum, springs.

chapters.title: Waves
chapters.blurb: Progressive waves, superposition, beats, stationary waves, Doppler effect.
